english.note: Use this child-directed or affectionate term when addressing or referring to one’s mum.
Use this family nickname for a mother, or when a father addresses his wife as the children's mom.

examples.jyutping: maa1 mi4 ngo5 soeng2 sik6 syut3 gou1

examples.english: Mom, Dad says it’s time to eat!
